titel: Dulce de leche from milk and sugar
kurz: Milk and sugar are reduced for hours until a brown caramel cream forms. A pinch of baking soda speeds up the browning.
bild_im_kopf: Like a sunset: it comes slowly, but step by step everything turns more golden.
sicherheit: Never boil sealed tins of condensed milk in water: if the pot boils dry, the tin can burst.
ergebnis: About 400 ml of dulce de leche.
haltbarkeit: A few weeks in the fridge.
material: wide pot with a thick base
verwendung: On bread, in alfajores, with ice cream.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Bring milk, sugar and vanilla to the boil, then stir in the baking soda
schluesselmomente.warum: Baking soda makes the [[milch|milk]] slightly alkaline. That speeds up browning and stops the milk curdling.
Water evaporates; sugar and milk protein concentrate.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Towards the end stir more often, until it is caramel brown and thick
schluesselmomente.warum: Milk sugar and milk protein react: colour and caramel aroma form below 100 °C because it takes so long.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Fill into clean jars while hot
schluesselmomente.warum: It thickens further as it cools.
